summary: Ground graph snapshot ingestion is accepted as canonical cross-project linkage context for planning because contract, integration, and hardening checks passed and evidence anchors preserve project-era-plan-phase-run lineage.
open_risks: Acceptance is bounded to fixture-backed evidence; production-scale graph volumes and live sweep latency are not exercised by this task evidence set.

Cross-project context remains consumable for planning, but recommendation output can legitimately contain explicit open_risks (for missing evidence or out-of-graph projects) and downstream planners must keep those unresolved risks visible.
